# vpsie_kubernetes (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vpsie_kubernetes" "example" {
  slave_count = 2
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_name` (String) Name of the cluster. Changing it forces a new cluster.
- `dc_identifier` (String) Identifier of the datacenter to deploy the cluster into. Changing it forces a new cluster.
- `kuber_ver` (String) Kubernetes version to deploy, as reported by the versions endpoint (for example `1.34.1`). Changing it forces a new cluster.
- `manager_count` (Number) Number of control-plane nodes. Changing it forces a new cluster.
- `project_identifier` (String) Identifier of the project that will own the cluster. Changing it forces a new cluster.
- `resource_identifier` (String) Identifier of the offer backing each node. This is the offer's datacenter-mapping identifier. Changing it forces a new cluster.
- `slave_count` (Number) Number of worker nodes. Changing it forces a new cluster.
- `vpc_id` (Number) Numeric id of the VPC the cluster is attached to. Changing it forces a new cluster.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `color` (String) Display colour reported for the cluster's offer.
- `cpu` (Number)
- `created_by` (String)
- `created_on` (String)
- `identifier` (String)
- `master_count` (Number)
- `nickname` (String)
- `nodes` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))
- `price` (Number)
- `ram` (Number)
- `traffic` (Number)
- `updated_on` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

Read-Only:

- `datacenter_id` (Number)

- `node_id` (Number)
- `node_type` (Number)
- `private_ip` (String)
- `user_id` (Number)
